title: Expense Reimbursement Trap
scenario: An employee submits a receipt link requiring finance to enter credentials.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.C: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: Expense Reimbursement Trap: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Expense evidence should not require finance login to third-party sites.
